_note: Armour sets that the GAME dyes a RANDOM colour on creation (not player-dyed, not OG/exotic). A piece from one of these sets showing an off-default colour is NOT a rare exotic — it just rolled a random colour. These are filed under the 'random_dyed' category with low priority so they sink below genuine exotics instead of flooding the feed. Matching is by item-id SUBSTRING (uppercased), so 'SATIN' catches SATIN_HELMET, SATIN_TROUSERS, etc. Edit freely — add a pattern to downrank a set, remove one to treat it normally. SATIN is the confirmed case; the rest are common random-dyed cosmetic sets and can be tuned.
